system.description:
Make an Interface Roll against a target
within Far range.
On a success, you use magnetic force,
remote machinery, grav-tech,
industrial drones, or a heavy
manipulator array to move them
anywhere within Far range of their
original position.
You can throw the lifted target as an
attack by making an additional
Interface Roll against the second target
you’re trying to attack.
On a success, deal d12+4 physical
damage to the second target using
your Proficiency.
This protocol then ends.
